risks: No Meeting content authority found within permitted seams; do not equate call/calendar-event/task meeting links with a canonical Meeting owner.
ProjectMembershipStore stores edges/visibility only; TaskProject is a separate personal-task type. Neither proves Macro Project authority/revision/readback.

NotesRepository seed Map is not the actual durable Notes engine; broad replacement or new Base-owned content Map would violate single authority. Async authority signatures/callers may require reviewed scope expansion.

Knowledge registry resolve falls back to scheme/default provider at provider.ts:179-193 and serializeKnowledgeRef omits connectionId at refs.ts:61-63. Adapters must resolve an explicitly accepted connection-bound canonical ref, not reuse these compact forms as globally unique row identity.
Calendar etag is optional; Task updatedAt is optional; provider normalized content hash trims/normalizes line endings. Do not fabricate revision or claim raw-file preservation from these values.

Actor principal, shared protocol registration, renderer/source-picker and locales are missing from the bounded writable scope. Tests alone cannot supply those integrations; lead-approved integration contract is required before claiming full DoD.
Sample3 is only a preview of authorized real rows, not fabricated demonstration data or a substitute for full query snapshot/ACL totals behavior.
Current caller-supplied readable flags/context sets/workspace selectors are not server authorization. Remote-private offline reads require approved lease policy and fail closed otherwise.

Published RS-BASE-01 baseline and new file list differ from LSX adapter packet. Preserve bounded ownership and explicitly reconcile foundation gates, rather than importing the entire published feature into this slice.
Root integration can invalidate file hashes during/after inspection; all readiness/runtime claims remain unverified until revision-bound acceptance receipts.
